# Soma Novel — Full Directory

> Machine-readable companion to /llms.txt. Generated from the published
> catalogue on 2026-09-22. Contains 224 titles and
> 1000 chapters.

## About Soma Novel / Kuhusu Soma Novel

Soma Novel is a free reading site from East Africa. Two catalogue sections, three things:

1. **Bilingual web fiction (爽文).** Every original serial is published side-by-side in English and Kiswahili, free to read online and free to download as a complete book. (Scope: original web fiction only.)
2. **Re-typeset English classics.** More than a thousand public-domain English works have been professionally re-typeset for phone screens, free to read online and free to download as a complete book. (Scope: classics section. English only — Kiswahili translations are not produced because the source language is English.)
3. **Self-publishing.** Readers can upload their own .txt or .epub manuscripts through the in-page uploader (English and Kiswahili both accepted), free of charge.

---

Soma Novel ni tovuti ya kusoma bure kutoka Afrika Mashariki. Sehemu mbili za orodha ya vitabu, mambo matatu:

1. **Riwaya za mtandaoni (爽文) katika lugha mbili.** Kila riwaya yetu ya asili inachapishwa kwa Kiingereza na Kiswahili, bure kusoma mtandaoni na bure kupakua kitabu kizima. (Wigo: riwaya za mtandaoni za asili pekee.)
2. **Vitabu vya kale vya Kiingereza vimepangwa upya.** Zaidi ya vitabu elfu moja vya kale vya Kiingereza vimepangwa upya kwa skrini za simu, bure kusoma mtandaoni na bure kupakua kitabu kizima. (Wigo: sehemu ya vitabu vya kale. Kiingereza pekee — tafsiri za Kiswahili hazitengenezwi kwa sababu lugha ya chanzo ni Kiingereza.)
3. **Kuchapisha mwenyewe.** Wasomaji wanaweza kupakia hati zao za .txt au .epub kupitia kifungu cha kupakia (Kiingereza na Kiswahili vinakubaliwa), bure.

### Nyumba Ya Hesabu

- Authors: Imani Zawadi
- Language: Kiswahili
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 5
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/nyumba-ya-hesabu-sw/
- Synopsis: Amina Sefu is summoned to a closed room at work and handed a suspension notice based on a complaint signed by her mother and younger brother. They claim she stole money left by their late father. Amina has spent years building her reputation by checking other people’s accounts, so the accusation threatens both her salary and her identity. When a records clerk gives her the complete attachment, she discovers that the complaint omitted the page naming the money as a reserve for a family water project and requiring two-person approval. To clear her name, Amina must cross the boundary between workplace evidence and family loyalty: trace the money, inspect the land, learn why her mother signed, and force her brother to admit what he borrowed. Her final choice is not simply whether to expose them, but whether the father’s land will remain a weapon controlled by one person or become a transparent promise shared by all.

### Mlango Wa Nyumba

- Authors: Rashid Pwani
- Language: Kiswahili
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 4
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/mlango-wa-nyumba-sw/
- Synopsis: Neema amekuwa akituma pesa za rehani, matibabu na matengenezo kwa nyumba ya Mama Asha kwa miaka kumi. Siku moja baada ya mazishi, anarudi Mtoni na kukuta kufuli jipya. Mosi, baba wa kambo aliyemwita baba tangu utotoni, anamwambia kwamba nyumba si yake na imebaki kwa Mosi na Kato pekee. Neema anapoanza kutafuta mahali pa kulala, anagundua kuwa simu ya mama imehifadhi picha za risiti ambazo Mosi hakujua zipo. Kato anajua jambo baya zaidi: alikuwepo wakati hati ya uhamisho ilisomwa, na mama hakuonekana kuelewa kila neno. Neema lazima athibitishe mchango wake bila kubadilisha huzuni kuwa vita ya kumfukuza mtu mwingine. Kila hatua inamrudisha kwenye swali moja: nyumba ya mama ilipaswa kumlinda nani, na ni nani aliyekuwa akitumia mlango huo kumiliki watu?

### Makubaliano Ya Siri

- Authors: Layla Pendo
- Language: Kiswahili
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 5
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/makubaliano-ya-siri-sw/
- Synopsis: Zawadi Mrema na Hassan Mollel walijenga Mavuno Link kwa miaka minane kwa mikopo, farmer trust na malori ya kukodi. Wakati Zawadi anapeleka malori matatu ya mahindi kwa Kiwanda cha Unga Kaskazini huku malipo ya zamani bado hayajalipwa, factory manager anasema account ilifungwa tayari. Settlement ina saini halisi ya Hassan. Zawadi anafikiri partner wake ameiba au kuuza kampuni kwa nusu bei, lakini ledger inaonyesha baadhi ya delivery differences ni za kweli. Hassan anapopatikana, anaficha kwamba settlement money ilienda kuzuia benki kuchukua nyumba yake—na nyumba hiyo ndiyo iliyowahi kuwekwa collateral wakati kampuni ilikuwa karibu kufa miaka iliyopita. Zawadi lazima atenganishe shukrani, betrayal, verified debt na future authority bila kuharibu farmers waliomwamini.

### Utajiri Wa Siri

- Authors: Idris Mwangaza
- Language: Kiswahili
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 4
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/utajiri-wa-siri-sw/
- Synopsis: Hamisi Jengo amefanya kila kitu ambacho watu humwambia mwanaume wa familia afanye: amefanya kazi, ameanzisha biashara, amelipa deni polepole, amesomesha watoto wake na amewasaidia ndugu mara nyingi. Tatizo ni kwamba kila mafanikio mapya yanaonekana kufungua mlango wa ombi jipya. Kwa hiyo ameunda mfumo wake wa kujilinda: ndugu wakija, nyumba inarudi nyuma miaka mitano. Runinga ya pili inaondolewa. Gari la biashara linaegeshwa kwa jirani. Leila anaambiwa asiseme kuhusu contract mpya. Hata mtoto wao Malik anajua sentensi ya kusema: “Baba bado anahangaika.” Kwa Hamisi huo ni ulinzi. Kwa Leila ni uongo unaokula nyumba yao kutoka ndani. Siku Malik anaporudia uongo huo mbele ya mwalimu na mteja wa biashara ya Hamisi anapotokea bila kutarajiwa wakati ndugu wamejaa sebuleni, “umaskini wa kuigiza” unageuka kutoka mbinu ndogo ya kifamilia kuwa tishio kwa ndoa, biashara na uhusiano wa mtoto na ukweli. Ili kuokoa familia yake, Hamisi lazima ajibu swali ambalo pesa pekee haiwezi kujibu: anaweza kuweka mpaka bila kujifanya mtu mwingine?

### Mlango Wa Wodi Ulikuwa Kimya

- Authors: Imani Zawadi
- Language: Kiswahili
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 5
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/mlango-wa-wodi-ulikuwa-kimya-sw/
- Synopsis: Salma Nuru anajua njia ya Hospitali ya Mkoa wa Bahari kwa macho yaliyofungwa. Ndiko alikopimwa, ndiko alikoambiwa mtoto wake anaendelea vizuri, na ndiko yeye na Musa walipanga kufika siku ya kujifungua. Lakini uchungu unapomshika usiku, wanakuta mlango wa wodi ukiwa wazi na viti vingi tupu. Hakuna tangazo linaloeleza ni huduma gani ipo, ni nani yuko zamu, wala ni hospitali gani inapokea wagonjwa waliohamishwa. Kila dakika ya kutafuta jibu inageuka kuwa pesa ya usafiri, hofu ya familia na hasira dhidi ya mtu asiye sahihi. Salma anapokutana na Neema, muuguzi ambaye amebaki kazini huku wenzake wakishinikiza madai ya muda mrefu, anagundua kwamba mgogoro huu haujaanza leo. Watu wamekuwa wakiziba mashimo ya mfumo kimya kimya kwa miezi, mpaka usiku ambao hawawezi tena. Riwaya inafuata familia na wahudumu wanaolazimika kubadili swali kutoka “nani ametuacha?” kwenda “ni nani alijua huduma ilikuwa inavunjika, na kwa nini hakuna aliyewaambia watu?”

### Risiti ya Marehemu

- Authors: Safiya Amani
- Language: Kiswahili
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 4
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/risiti-ya-marehemu-sw/
- Synopsis: Salma, mjane wa miaka arobaini na sita, anataka kuweka rehani ua wa nyumba za kupangisha ili kumlipia binti yake Leila chuo. Kabla Salma hajamfukuza, Hassan—mwana wake mkubwa na mtu aliyemsaidia kusimamia mali baada ya kifo—anakiri kuwa alijua Baraka ni nani miaka mitatu iliyopita. Salma anasitisha rehani na kuanza kufukua hesabu za mume wake, akigundua kuwa swali la urithi si “mgeni anataka nini?” pekee, bali “mwana wangu alificha nini, mume wangu aliishi maisha gani, na mimi nataka familia yangu iwe nini sasa?”

### Store of Tomorrow

- Authors: Nia Kendi
- Language: English
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 4
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/store-of-tomorrow/
- Synopsis: For eleven years, Tunu Sengo has rolled up the metal shutters of Duka la Kesho every morning before the sun clears the tin roofs of Mavuno Street. Her customers trust her to revive phones that others wrote off, suppliers know she pays slowly but without fail, and her landlord knows she has never been more than two days late on rent. Then a sudden rumor spreads through the market: businesses held under certain residency categories are about to be shut down. There is no official notice on her door and no municipal inspector has arrived, yet customers hesitate, suppliers freeze credit, her landlord starts asking uneasy questions, and a competitor three doors down begins measuring her shopfront with hungry eyes. When Tunu visits the municipal office, she uncovers an even harder truth: there is no immediate closure, but there is a strict 21-day compliance window—and her file contains a historical registration flaw that no current receipt can paper over. To save her livelihood without becoming a victim or surrendering the shop to a nominal partner, Tunu must navigate a labyrinth of old documents, resist unlawful harassment, and prove that the business she built with her own hands can remain hers under the law.

### The Fake Stamp

- Authors: Daudi Zawadi
- Language: English
- Category: Thriller
- Chapters: 4
- URL: https://somanovel.uk/books/the-fake-stamp/
- Synopsis: Elias Mhando has just been promoted to bursar at a community secondary school struggling to pay its temporary teachers and repair the roof before the rains begin. Only days after taking charge of the school's financial seal, an official-looking directive from the education board demands an urgent contribution for teacher interview expenses before noon. Neighboring headmasters confirm they have already paid, and his own deputy head urges him not to waste time. But Elias spots a single discrepancy in the account number compared to past records. If he halts the payment, he risks being seen as incompetent and destroying his new position; if he pays, he could be the one who handed student funds to fraudsters. His quiet inquiry escalates from a question of shillings into a high-stakes struggle over who gets to declare what is "official"—and why educated men and women still fear being the first to ask questions.
